events.title: Xerox Holdings Stock Rises 15.6% Since Q1 Earnings Release
events.body: XRX tops Q1 estimates with strong revenue growth and narrower loss, sending shares up 15.6% despite ongoing long-term stock pressure.

events.title: FTI Consulting Stock Declines 6.3% Since Q2 Earnings Miss
events.body: FCN misses Q2 EPS estimates despite revenue growth, sending shares down 6.3% as mixed segment performance and margin pressure weigh.
